note: Night Shift activity types and starter idea library (docs/specs/fun-factory.md sections 4 and 6). enabled = live at launch. Vault ideas use actions (want, add, cover); rating ideas wait under the disabled ratings type until members can rate games.

activityTypes.name: Daily check-in
activityTypes.description: Punch the clock once per Central day on the Night Shift page.

activityTypes.name: Visit pages
activityTypes.description: Visit sections of the site (each section counts once per day; a site tour counts different sections).

activityTypes.name: Find hidden medals
activityTypes.description: Find medals hidden on site pages during a hunt.

activityTypes.name: Profile and linked accounts
activityTypes.description: Make the profile yours: a profile picture, a persona, linked accounts.

activityTypes.name: Boom Arcade
activityTypes.description: Play the Boom Arcade: play a run (any result), finish a run, beat your best, place on a board.

activityTypes.name: Earn badges
activityTypes.description: Earn Trophy Room badges: any badge, or one from a collection or of a rarity.

activityTypes.name: Game Vault
activityTypes.description: Help build the Game Vault: "I want this too" on wishlist games, games you add that make it in, cover suggestions that get approved.

activityTypes.name: Bring a friend
activityTypes.description: A friend you brought to the site becomes an active member (a referral activates after 7 days with a real action).

activityTypes.name: Your recruit checks in
activityTypes.description: A friend you brought checks in to Night Shift for the first time.

activityTypes.name: Member ratings
activityTypes.description: Rate a game in the Game Vault (through the Service Hub's rating buttons).

activityTypes.name: Bug Zapper
activityTypes.description: Help fix the site: report a bug, get a report confirmed.

activityTypes.name: Feature Lab
activityTypes.description: Help shape the site and the stream: post an idea on the board, vote on other members' ideas, and see your own idea ship.

activityTypes.name: Service Hub
activityTypes.description: Rate the site's services, run a service's test checks, and rate every core service open to you.

activityTypes.name: Stream presence
activityTypes.description: Be at a live stream: check in to a beat with the word on stream, check in to every beat, be counted present (chat, a drop or a check-in), or be one of the first three in.

themes.name: Dark Signal
themes.pitch: A strange broadcast is leaking into the stream. Trace it to its source.

themes.name: Vaultbreakers
themes.pitch: The vault is sealed. The community cracks it open, one key at a time.

themes.name: Neon Depths
themes.pitch: A flooded neon city where something down below glows back.

themes.name: Overtime
themes.pitch: The factory that never closes is hiring for the late shift.

themes.name: The Hollow Asylum
themes.pitch: The wards of a sanitarium that never really closed.

themes.name: Cursed Cartridge
themes.pitch: An old game cartridge that starts playing you back.

themes.name: Blood Moon Carnival
themes.pitch: The carnival only opens under a red moon.

themes.name: Static Woods
themes.pitch: A forest where the old radios still talk.

themes.name: The Last Broadcast
themes.pitch: Found footage: piece together the final tape.

themes.name: Frostbite Station
themes.pitch: A research station at the bottom of the world goes silent.

themes.name: Haunted Arcade
themes.pitch: After closing time, the machines switch themselves on.

themes.name: The Infection
themes.pitch: Something is spreading through the community. Contain it, or join it.

themes.name: Witching Hour
themes.pitch: Every night at 3 am, the rules change.

themes.name: Deep Space Distress
themes.pitch: A derelict ship answers your call.

themes.name: Grave Shift
themes.pitch: Dig up the secrets buried behind the stream.

themes.name: The Doll House
themes.pitch: Tiny rooms, big secrets, and they're watching.

themes.name: Sinkhole
themes.pitch: The ground opened under town. Something is climbing out.

themes.name: Pumpkin Rot
themes.pitch: Harvest season in a town that feeds on its own.

themes.name: Silent Night Terrors
themes.pitch: Holiday cheer turns to holiday fear.

themes.name: Summer Camp Slasher
themes.pitch: Cabin assignments, campfire stories, and a masked visitor.

activities.title: Punch the clock
activities.instructions: Press Punch the clock on the Night Shift page.

activities.title: Play a round
activities.instructions: Play any game in the Boom Arcade.

activities.title: Rate a game
activities.instructions: Rate any game in the Game Vault.

activities.title: Vote on ideas
activities.instructions: Vote on 3 ideas in Feature Lab.

activities.title: Check in to the stream
activities.instructions: Enter today's stream code while live.

activities.title: Claim a drop
activities.instructions: Claim any live drop.

activities.title: Answer the daily poll
activities.instructions: Vote in today's poll.

activities.title: Five-day shift
activities.instructions: Punch the clock on 5 days this week.

activities.title: Splat run
activities.instructions: Finish Tap the Splat 3 times.

activities.title: Personal best
activities.instructions: Beat your best time in any Arcade game.

activities.title: Vault critic
activities.instructions: Rate 3 games in the Game Vault.

activities.title: Wishlist voter
activities.instructions: Tap I want this too on 3 games on the wishlist.

activities.title: Into the Vault
activities.instructions: Add a game that makes it into the Vault.

activities.title: Cover artist
activities.instructions: Get a cover suggestion approved.

activities.title: Bug hunter
activities.instructions: Report a bug in Bug Zapper.

activities.title: Big idea
activities.instructions: Post an idea in Feature Lab.

activities.title: Collector
activities.instructions: Earn any badge this week.

activities.title: Two-stream week
activities.instructions: Be at 2 live streams this week.

activities.title: Pick the games
activities.instructions: Vote on next week's schedule.

activities.title: Join the conversation
activities.instructions: Reply to 3 comments.

activities.title: Spread the love
activities.instructions: Send a shout-out to another member.

activities.title: Site tour
activities.instructions: Visit 6 sections of the site: Games, Arcade, Schedule, Streams, Shop and Trophy Room.

activities.title: Hidden medals
activities.instructions: Find the 5 medals hidden around the site.

activities.title: Make it yours
activities.instructions: Add a profile picture and pick a persona.

activities.title: Link up
activities.instructions: Link your Twitch, YouTube and TikTok accounts.

activities.title: Show it off
activities.instructions: Pin 3 badges to your trophy case.

activities.title: Finish the season's game
activities.instructions: Finish the featured Arcade game once.

activities.title: Month of shifts
activities.instructions: Punch the clock on 30 days this season.

activities.title: Critic's corner
activities.instructions: Rate 50 games in the Game Vault.

activities.title: Ten badges
activities.instructions: Earn 10 badges this season.

activities.title: Exterminator

activities.title: Front row season

activities.title: Pumpkin patch hunt
activities.instructions: Find the 7 pumpkins hidden for Halloween.

activities.title: Game night

activities.title: Anniversary stream

activities.title: Inner circle run

activities.title: Mod patrol

activities.title: Chapter recap

activities.title: Clip it
